  File: tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts (LAST RUN DIFF hunk adds 6 workflow filenames to ALLOWED_WORKFLOW_FILES)

  Problem: This is a trust-boundary expansion of the Claude pool broker (CLAUDE.md §24.C, agents.md "Cloudflare resources" entry for claude-pool-broker). It grants credential issuance to six additional workflows, which has nothing to do with any of the 11 security-pass findings. The change is forward-looking (Worker must be redeployed with `wrangler deploy` to take effect) and is being mixed into a security-pass PR without an issue/task binding it to the project's risk cycle.
  Why it fails at runtime: Once the Worker is redeployed, six additional workflows can fetch the Claude OAuth token from the broker. Because that grant is bundled into a security-pass PR, an operator reviewing #6664 cycle 4 cannot tell whether this expansion is intended, audited, or whether any of those six workflows even needs the pool today.
  
  File: tests/test_review_synthesise_smoke.py (LAST RUN DIFF hunks change `assert len(launch_lines) == 2` → `== 1` and the launch-line string)
  File: tests/test_validate_driver_synthesised_filter.py (LAST RUN DIFF hunks change `bash "${test_file}"` → `run_test_without_credentials "${test_file}"` and `bash validation/validate.sh > "${VALIDATION_LOG_FILE}"` → `bash "${VALIDATION_HARNESS_SANDBOX_SCRIPT}" run "${GENERATED_VALIDATE_SCRIPT_PATH}"`)
  File: changelog.d/validate-roles-claude-engine.md (LAST RUN DIFF hunk adds the broker-grant note)
  Problem: These updates retarget validation-harness tests at a launch path (single sandboxed launch through `VALIDATION_HARNESS_SANDBOX_SCRIPT run`) and document the broker grant. None of these surfaces are part of the 11 findings — they are validation harness work unrelated to the security pass. The corresponding source changes in scripts/validate_process.sh and scripts/validate_driver.sh are not in the LAST RUN DIFF (the source already has `run_test_without_credentials "${test_file}"` at scripts/validate_driver.sh:997 and scripts/validate_process.sh:1618, and the sandboxed launch line at scripts/validate_process.sh:4254), so the test deltas are tightening assertions on code that this PR is not touching. Bundling them with the security-pass PR obscures whether any validation-harness regression is part of the cycle-4 fix.
  Why it fails at runtime: A reviewer reading cycle 4 will see test changes against the validation harness with no diff hunk against the harness itself in this PR; if the harness drifts, the test changes look like mismatched scope rather than a regression fix.
